ORDINANCE V OF 1976
ORDINANCE V OF 1976
POLITICAL PARTIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1976
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Political Parties (Amendment) Ordinance,
1976.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken ;effect on the twenty‑ninth day of
October, 1975.

Amendment of section 8 Act III of 1962

ORDINANCE V OF 1976
ORDINANCE V OF 1976
POLITICAL PARTIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1976
2. Amendment of section 8, Act 111 of X962.‑In the Political
Parties Act, 1962 (III of 1962), for section 8 the following shall be
substituted, namely :‑
"8. Certain disqualifications for being a member of Parliament or
a Pro vincial Assembly.‑A person who has‑
(i) at any time on or after the
twentieth day of December, 1971, beers an office‑bearer of a political
party dissolved under subsection (2) of section 6 and has not, before a declaration
in respect of such party is made by the Federal Government under subsection (1)
of that section, resigned from, or publicly announced his dissociation with,
such party ; or
(ii) been convicted under
section 7, shall be disqualified from being a member of Parliament or a
Provincial Assembly and from being elected or chosen as such a member for a
period of five years from the date of such dissolution or conviction, as the
case my be.
Explanation.‑In this
section, "office‑bearer of a political party" means an office‑bearer
at the National or Provincial set up of the party, but does not include a
person---
( a) who is merely a member of
the Working, Central, Provincial or other Committee of the party ; or
(b) who is an office‑bearer
of the party below the Provincial setup‑--.
